description: Sturmschaden in Sachsen vom 24.05.2010 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by forsten.sachsen.de. A Web Map Service (WMS) of the state enterprise Sachsenforst. The map service includes the digital orthographic data from the storm event on May 24, 2010 in Saxony. Shown is a 6 km wide strip with the area delimitation from Söllichau (northwest) to Großharthau (southeast). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Storm damage in Saxony from 24.05.2010" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Holz, Waldlebensgemeinschaft, Landschaften, Waldgebiet, Forst, Kalamität. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2015-07-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
